title: Figure 29: Illustration of Cuprophane dialysis membrane filtering blood waste
description: Color illustration of red blood cells on one side of a layered orange-and-yellow membrane, with small violet and orange dots passing through its pores. Caption: "Figure 29. Cuprophane Membrane Passes Blood Waste Products (Violet and Orange Dots) Through Pores and Blocks Passage of Red Blood Cells." The page also contains the report's 'Summary and Recommendations' section.
